description: Priority inversion in interrupt handler due to missing critical section
user_question: Is there a race condition with shared_counter accessed from ISR and main loop?
expected_root_cause: shared_counter accessed from both interrupt handler and main loop without atomic access or critical section
expected_fix: Use __atomic_fetch_add or disable interrupts around shared_counter access in main loop

expected_code_issues.suggestion: Use atomic operations or critical sections for shared variables

expected_follow_up_required: Verify interrupt priorities and consider using atomic builtins
